title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Beer and Wine Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking to make the most of your afternoon in Niagara Wine Country? Join us for an unforgettable beer and wine adventure, led by Niagara's top industry professionals. Taste your way through some of the finest wines and craft beers in the region, all while exploring stunning wineries and a premier brewery.

Don't miss out on this fun, educational, and immersive afternoon tour through Niagara’s wine and beer scene—perfect for wine and beer lovers alike! Book now to reserve your spot!
